question: In Linear: Set the estimate to 3 for the Todo issue assigned to Maya Chen in the Web team with the Bug label from the Web team.
final:
I set the estimate on WEB-1, "Checkout button unresponsive on Safari", to 3. It was 2 before.

Maya Chen has three Todo issues in the Web team that carry a Bug label, but WEB-1 is the only one whose Bug label belongs to the Web team:
- **WEB-4:** its Bug label belongs to the Mobile team, so I left it alone.
- **WEB-5:** its Bug label also belongs to the Mobile team (its Web label is Feature), so I left it alone.
